tests.name: Customer message sliding window limit (service level)
tests.details: First 20 allowed; 21-25 rejected immediately by sliding window algorithm.

tests.name: Visitor rate limit isolation (service level)
tests.details: Rate limit bucket is strictly isolated per visitorId.

tests.name: Agent AI cooldown enforcement (service level)
tests.details: Immediate call blocked with 5s remaining; allowed after cooldown elapsed.

tests.name: Customer message rate limit over WebSocket (socket level)
tests.errorMessage: Rate limit exceeded: Please wait before sending more messages.
tests.details: Server emitted app:error on messages 21-25 with exact message: "Rate limit exceeded: Please wait before sending more messages."

inMemoryArchitectureNotes.storage: JavaScript Map() in server memory (agentCooldowns, customerMessageBuckets)
inMemoryArchitectureNotes.persistence: Ephemeral (lost on process restart or crash)
inMemoryArchitectureNotes.horizontalScaling: Single-instance only; does NOT synchronize across multi-process or multi-server clusters without Redis or an external key-value store
